name: Dual Weapon Master
prerequisites: Must have the Dual Wielding fighting style
description:
You master fighting with two weapons, gaining the following benefits:
- You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand.
- You can use two-weapon fighting as long as none of the weapons you are holding are two-handed
- When at least one of the weapons you hold is light, two-weapon fighting is a free action. However, you may only use two-weapon fighting once per turn.
